verdict.rationale: Superpowers documents no install-scope choice of its own. Its porting guide says everything ships through each harness's own install mechanism, so scope is decided by the host platform. The project-local copy into ./.claude/skills/ came from the separate third-party `npx skills` installer, and the `~/.agents/skills/` path is a harness-recognised location. Both are host or external tooling, not a Superpowers capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects
